ns2:section.sectionText: PLEASE NOTE: THIS COURSE IS MOSTLY SELF-PACED, BUT CLASS WILL MEET IN FACE-TO-FACE FORMAT ON SEPTEMBER 2 AND OCTOBER 21. First class meeting is September 2; last class/national certification exam is October 21. Registration is restricted to Hospitality Management and Dietetic majors until after junior registration, and then remaining seats open to all majors. FSHN minors must contact the department office for registration authorization (333-1324). If you get a 'course full' error message and want to be added to a wait list for this class, go to www.fshn.illinois.edu and click on Undergraduate then Course Wait List. Wait lists will not open until one week before classes start in August. Until that time, it is up to you to continue to check the status of this course to see if a seat has become available for you.
